$schema: Vetted real-imagery photo tiles for galaxies. Each entry keyed by DSO catalog id (e.g., 'NGC4594' for M104 Sombrero). Add entries only when sourced from HST/JWST/ESO/STScI archival imagery. Tier paths are relative to /assets/textures/galaxies/<id>/. License + attribution required. 'projection' (default 'equirect') selects the render path: 'flat-disc' = flat plate textured on a true 3D inclined disc + bulge; 'equirect' = legacy spheremap on the volume sphere.

NGC4594.attribution: NASA/ESA and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
